data.name: WorkspaceFolder_Absolute
data.value: The folder '{0}' that {1} lists is not loaded: it is an absolute path, and a workspace lists only folders directly under its own root.

data.name: WorkspaceFolder_OutsideRoot
data.value: The folder '{0}' that {1} lists is not loaded: it climbs out of the workspace root with '..'.

data.name: WorkspaceFolder_NotDirectlyUnderRoot
data.value: The folder '{0}' that {1} lists is not loaded: a workspace lists the folders directly under its root, by their names.

data.name: WorkspaceFolder_Duplicate
data.value: The folder '{0}' that {1} lists is not loaded again: the file lists it earlier.

data.name: WorkspaceFolder_Missing
data.value: The folder '{0}' that {1} lists is not loaded: there is no such folder under the workspace root.

data.name: WorkspaceRoot_Differs
data.value: The client opened the folder '{0}', and the server was started on '{1}': the workspace is '{0}', its settings included.
